about.title: Path
about.photoAlt: Portrait of Adam Beloucif, smiling, in a white shirt and navy waistcoat
bio: I am a PMSI engineer on a work-study contract in the medical information department of a psychiatric hospital group, and a student in the Master's in Data Engineering & AI at EFREI.
My day to day: regulatory health data, dashboards for management control, pipelines in SQL, PL/SQL, PHP and Python. On the side, I build school projects and products for my studio, BLF Lab's.
My background is mixed, between communication and engineering, and I use it: I can explain a dataset to someone who is not a data person.

privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This website sets no tracking cookie, uses no audience analytics tool and loads no resource from a third-party site. The only processing of personal data is the contact form.

p: The form collects your name, your email address and your message. This data is used only to reply to you.
My legitimate interest in replying to people who write to me (article 6(1)(f) of the GDPR).
Messages are kept for twelve months after the last exchange, then deleted.
Resend, which forwards the message by email, and Vercel, which hosts the website. These providers may process data outside the European Union, under standard contractual clauses.
Your choice of light or dark theme is remembered in your browser (key ab-theme). It contains no personal data, never leaves your device and is used only for display.
You can ask for access to, correction or erasure of your data, object to its processing or ask for it to be restricted, by writing to adam.beloucif@efrei.net.
You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr) if you believe your rights are not respected.
